scope: Track A Launch-Now / Zero-Possession integrity-receipt lane

threats.threat: Raw document bytes are transmitted to the receipt endpoint, undermining zero-possession.
threats.required_control: Reject document/file/content byte fields and accept only a SHA-256 fingerprint plus bounded nonce.

threats.threat: Weak signing material enables receipt forgery.
threats.required_control: Reject integrity-signing keys shorter than 256 bits.

threats.threat: A receipt is altered after issue but still accepted.
threats.required_control: HMAC verification must fail after any protected field or signature mutation.

threats.threat: Technical integrity assurance is misrepresented as statutory certification or issuer verification.
threats.required_control: Public label and receipt truth boundary must remain non-statutory and non-issuer-verifying unless separate proof exists.

threats.threat: Track A is made dependent on identity/commissioner claims or implicitly releases a legal certification label.
threats.required_control: Track A integrity receipt remains launchable without IDV and cannot release CERTIFIED_COPY/COMMISSIONED_AFFIDAVIT without the legal completion path.

threats.threat: Source/test readiness is treated as permission for unauthenticated public launch.
threats.required_control: Provider canary contract remains zero traffic, authenticated and explicitly not a public-launch authorisation.

threats.threat: Unbounded or malformed receipt inputs enable abuse or resource exhaustion.
threats.required_control: SHA-256 format and nonce length are bounded; HTTP body size is capped by the service.

threats.threat: Provider deployment logic reads or prints signing secret payloads during source-side preflight.
threats.required_control: Source-side deployment contract refers to a Secret Manager handle and never accesses or emits secret payload values.

truth_boundary: This threat model is a source/test security control. It is not an independent penetration test, legal approval, provider IAM audit or proof of public-production security.
